referents.why: 'To them' (autois) after 'released': the crowd are the ones released to. Plural pronoun for collective ochlos, agreement by sense as in Mrk.15.11.
Subject of 'he delivered' and of the participle 'having flogged': Pilate.
referents.category: implied subject of a finite clause

referents.why: Subject of the purpose clause 'that he might be crucified' (hina plus subjunctive). The one flogged and handed over is Jesus. The builder's Pilate would make the one who is crucified the agent of it.

links.why: Participle 'desiring' is a role of the main verb.
Infinitive 'to satisfy' completes the participle 'desiring' (the object of wishing), not a purpose.
Participle 'having flogged' is a role of the main verb.
Hina plus subjunctive, third person: what the handing over is for.
Narrative sequence: the release is followed by the flogging and handing over. De kai continues the line of events.
The infinitive is nested inside the participle, not a next event; the narrative line runs cl0 then cl3.

cant_tell.why: The implied object, Jesus, has no slot in the list.
